# The Steil Group (STEIL)

> GTM-as-a-Service for B2B software and data companies.

The Steil Group, known as STEIL, is a growth agency that serves as the outsourced marketing function for B2B software and data companies with $15–50M in revenue. Founded by Ryan "RC" Campbell, STEIL delivers integrated marketing strategy and full-channel execution — accountable to pipeline and EBITDA, not impressions.

## What STEIL Does

STEIL works across four core areas:

1. Develop an integrated marketing strategy across print, digital, conferences, and AI
2. Pressure-test GTM strategy and iterate quickly
3. Capture bottom-of-funnel traffic and establish competitive differentiation
4. Align sales and marketing for better connectivity across the GTM

## Services

- AI Ad Placement
- Google Ads
- Programmatic Display & Video
- Managed Conference Experiences
- Print Campaigns
- SEO
- AI Search Visibility
- Email & Direct Mail
- Creative & Design
- LinkedIn ABM

## Who STEIL Helps

STEIL works with CEOs, CROs, VPs of Sales, and VPs of Marketing at B2B software and data companies. Typical clients are mid-market companies ($15–50M revenue) that need enterprise-grade marketing capability without building a full in-house team.

## Results From Past Engagements

- +50% new-logo pipeline growth
- 7x increase in valuation
- +30% new-logo growth

Past engagements include work with HiLabs, Powerfleet, and Derive Systems.
